system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Your ability to superheat the environment around you in a variety of ways, modulating your Molten Terrain, in a variety of ways, causing it to have a variety of effects based on your choices, first of which is granting allied creatures immunity to the harmful effects of your Molten Terrain. Select three of the following Foundations. When you create Molten Terrain, you can choose two of your selected foundations, applying their effects to the Molten Terrain. You can select an additional foundations at 7th and 15th levels. If a foundation calls for a saving throw, use your highest jutsu save DC. If you have two or more foundations that require a saving throw, pick one saving throw between the two. If the affected creature fails, they suffer the effects of both.

Buoyant

The magma becomes semi-fluid, but supportive. Allied creatures that begin their turns on this terrain gain a +15 bonus to their speed, advantage on saving throws to resist being forcefully moved or knocked Prone and hostile creatures cannot take attacks of opportunity against their movement.

Dense

Structures and Barriers summoned/conjured as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Earth or Fire release keywords on this terrain gain 4 DR. This increases to 8 DR at 7th and 12 DR at 15th level.

Obscuring

Blazing heat shimmer distorts perception. This terrain is treated as lightly obscured for creatures not standing on it. Beginning at 11th level, hostile creatures cannot target creatures with attacks standing on this terrain, unless they are also within the area of the terrain.

Reactive Heat

Once per turn, hostile creatures that take Acid, Earth or Fire damage while on this terrain, causes the terrain to erupt with volatile energy, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain a rank of Burn.

Rubbery

Allied creatures that take damage while standing on this terrain have some of the harm they suffer shared with the terrain. They take 4 less damage. This increases to 8 damage at 7th level and 12 damage at 15th level.

| #### Lava Chakra Mode / Battle Amp / Your body is engulfed in Lava in the shape of a battle armor of your design. You gain the following benefits for the duration; / You gain a +2 Bonus to your AC. / When you create a Molten Terrain, as a result of the Magma Domain feature, you can creature 2 Molten Terrains simultaneously. / Hostile creatures that deal damage to you as a result of a melee attack, takes 10 fire damage. / Difficult terrain you create using jutsu with the Earth Release keyword can be treated as Molten Terrain. / When you inflict ranks of Burned as a result of a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, you can instead inflict the Molten condition. |

Scalding

Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain take 1d6 fire damage. This increases to 3d6 at 7th level and 5d6 at 15th level.

Shifting

The terrain becomes a siphon, draining energy, stamina and heat. Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they make concentration checks at disadvantage and increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.

Sticky

Creatures that begin their turn on this terrain must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, their speed is reduced by 15 feet and they cannot take the Dash, Disengage or Dodge actions until the end of their next turns.

Toxic

Once per turn, hostile creatures that take Wind, Poison or Necrotic damage while on this terrain, causes the terrain to erupt with volatile energy, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain a rank of Envenomed.
